	focus = {
		id = PRS_integrate_egypt
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_national_unity
		prerequisite = { focus = PRS_king_of_the_world }
		x = 8
		y = 8
		cost = 15
		search_filters = { FOCUS_FILTER_POLITICAL }
		available_if_capitulated = yes
		mutually_exclusive = { focus = PRS_free_egypt }
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = PRS_TT_UNREST_EGYPT_BELOW_20 check_variable = { PRS_unrest_egypt < 20 } }
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = PRS_TT_SETTLE_EGYPT NOT = { country_exists = KMT } any_owned_state = { is_core_of = KMT } }
		}
		completion_reward = {
			log = "ANTE|[GetDateText]|focus|[ROOT.GetTag]|PRS_integrate_egypt"
			set_country_flag = PRS_integrated_egypt
			custom_effect_tooltip = PRS_TT_INTEGRATED_EGYPT
			hidden_effect = {
				set_variable = { PRS_unrest_egypt = 0 }
				PRS_unrest_update = yes
				every_state = {
					limit = { is_core_of = KMT }
					remove_core_of = KMT
					if = { limit = { is_owned_by = ROOT } add_core_of = ROOT }
				}
			}
			add_stability = 0.03
			add_political_power = 50
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 3 }
	}
